cases.name: Deborah Geralyn Lyles
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me, "Debbie served in the U.S. Army for 31 years and 8 months from October 9, 1990 to November 30, 2022, and retired on December 1, 2022 as a Master Sergeant. Debbie (MSG Lyles) was adored by the Soldiers and leaders wherever she served, and was a friend to everyone she met. She was generous to a fault with her time and her love. She will be sorely missed by all. She was a Sexual Harassment and Assault Victim Advocate, and a Suicide prevention/response coordinator. She was a dedicated and fierce advocate for those who could not speak for or help themselves."
